name: value-to-market
description: Turn great ideas into value customers can feel. Value to Market applies the Value-to-Market (V2M) Framework by Hoang Huynh through one skill organized by the job you need done: assess a value proposition (yours, a rival's, a whole industry), build one from a known business or from scratch, fine-tune it when the market moves, build a value strategy (optionally with parallel agents that scout, draft and attack rival strategies), turn it into a Value to Market plan with launch strikes, events, social and horizon playbooks, and realign plan and strategy with what really happened. Start with /v2m init, or just ask.
